answer: EigenTrust aggregates normalized peer endorsements, while reciprocity-weighted transitivity discounts unsupported praise; reputation then decays exponentially with a defined half-life, so sustained honest service is needed to retain influence. Freshly spawned sybil identities—whether called opal, shale, or fable—have near-zero eigenvector centrality without trusted paths and cannot pass consensus merely by multiplying identities; they must earn durable, corroborated trust.
